name: Takamine Atsushi
source: The protagonist of the hidden "Fireworks" scenario. [url=/c140352]Takamine Takashi[/url]'s father. Executive of the home appliance manufacturer "Yotsubishi". He is very awkward and cannot express his feelings honestly, so he pretends to be strict to hide this. However, his son Takashi could not tolerate his behavior and left home.
